research_question: On development cases selected only from independent Codex failures and never executed by the current verified atomic-handoff runner, does the fixed EnvSolve-Pro mechanism improve paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 over a fresh goal-aware free Agent using the same model?

rule: Start from every deterministic confirmed Official failure and confirmed pre-Official system failure in the independent Codex census casebook.
Exclude Quacc, Ajenti, and Hark because they generated the current handoff mechanism and have current-treatment outcomes.
Exclude plugin.video.netflix, cvxportfolio, and Evox because the casebook marks their empty package-index outcomes causally unresolved and forbids deriving an algorithm rule from them.
Include every remaining eligible case in casebook order; do not rank by expected repairability, difficulty, repository contents, or any current-treatment outcome.
selection.interpretation: The current treatment is prospectively unopened, but repository identities and older deployment trajectories are consumed development evidence. This is not held-out or fully unseen evaluation.

A_FO.description: One continuous unrestricted Agent session with ordinary execution feedback and the complete public goal visible; no scheduled trusted observation or in-session target-state replay.

B_FOHR.description: The fixed EnvSolve-Pro mechanism: scheduled complete-goal observation, next-request cumulative-program handoff after Pass, fresh target-state replay, and unrestricted same-session repair after replay failure.

shared: DeepInfra through OpenRouter with fallbacks disabled
initial repository and complete public-goal information
minimal evaluator and repository integrity boundary
fresh source checkout and EnvBench Official evaluator
broad request, command, wall-time, and provider-retry safety limits

execution.matching: Fresh A and B rollouts use the same requested seed within each pair. Independent model rollouts remain stochastic.
execution.order: Alternate A-first and B-first by casebook position.
execution.parallelism: Two five-pair lanes; each pair remains wholly within one lane.

endpoints.primary: Paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 over every scientifically eligible pair, including valid non-submission as failure.
endpoints.path_quality: Official success and deployment completeness are separate axes.

analysis.primary_population: All scientifically eligible scheduled pairs; infrastructure-invalid episodes are censored rather than counted as algorithm failures.
analysis.statistics: Report the exact paired discordance table and two-sided exact McNemar result without treating statistical significance as an algorithm-selection threshold.
analysis.resources: Report unconditionally and on common-success pairs. Resource use is an outcome, not a hard threshold.
analysis.whole_batch_rule: Do not change the algorithm, prompt, cadence, boundary, or case set after any episode outcome. Complete and adjudicate the whole scheduled batch before interpretation.

claim_boundary: This can support only a development stress-test effect for the current treatment on an independently screened failure stratum.
It cannot establish held-out success, population success rate, generalization, leaderboard performance, statistical significance, or SOTA.
Older trajectories from these repositories informed the broad research program, so treatment-unopened must not be called identity-unseen.
No package-specific rule, checkpoint, cross-case memory, harness-selected repair, or new boundary change may be derived during the batch.
